docs.title: What is ZarinEngine / Что такое ZarinEngine
docs.text:
EN: ZarinEngine is a 3D game and simulation engine written entirely in Python — ECS-based, Unity-like workflow (hierarchy, components, inspector, prefabs), with a full PySide6 visual editor and real-time ModernGL rendering. MPL-2.0, © 2026 Zarrakun.

RU: ZarinEngine — 3D-игровой и симуляционный движок целиком на Python: ECS, Unity-подобный уклад (иерархия, компоненты, инспектор, префабы), полноценный визуальный редактор на PySide6 и real-time рендер на ModernGL. MPL-2.0, © 2026 Zarrakun.

docs.title: Quick start / Быстрый старт
docs.text:
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py
python player.py SampleScene.zpes
python build_nuitka.py

EN: main.py opens the editor; player.py <scene.zpes> runs a game from a scene file; build_nuitka.py compiles a standalone player (Nuitka, defaults in tools/nuitka/config.py, per-project scenes/plugins in the Build Settings dialog — repo-root sample _build_BuildSettings.json; no build_profiles.json exists in the repo).

RU: main.py открывает редактор; player.py <scene.zpes> запускает игру из файла сцены; build_nuitka.py собирает standalone-плеер (Nuitka, дефолты в tools/nuitka/config.py, сцены/плагины проекта — в диалоге Build Settings; образец в корне _build_BuildSettings.json; build_profiles.json в репо нет).

docs.title: Blendshapes Guide
docs.text: Per-mesh morph weights (facial expressions, muscle bulge). The BlendShapes component stores shapes: [{name, weight}]; the renderer reads weights_vector() aligned to the mesh's blendshape_names.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text:
Item Value shapes [] default; entries {"name": str, "weight": float} Weight clamp _clamp_weight: non-numeric/NaN/±inf → 0.0 get_weight(name_or_index) / set_weight(name_or_index, value) By name or index; set_weight appends unknown names, bumps _weights_version, returns whether anything changed reset_weights() Zeroes all, returns whether anything changed sync_with_mesh(mesh) Rebuilds shapes from mesh.blendshape_names, preserving known weights weights_vector(mesh=None) Weights in mesh order when a mesh is given, else in shapes order Import core/assets/importer settings: {"blendshapes": True} → mesh.py calls _finalize_blendshapes → blendshape_names / indices / positions / normals

No gen_blendshapes helper exists in the codebase: the verified import path is the asset importer above plus sync_with_mesh.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.components.rendering.deform.blendshapes import BlendShapes

bs = BlendShapes()
bs.set_weight("Smile", 0.8)   # appends {"name": "Smile", "weight": 0.8}
bs.set_weight(0, 0.5)          # by index
print(bs.get_weight("Smile"), bs.weight_count, bs.weight_names)
entity.add_component(bs)

# after assigning a mesh with morphs, align the list:
# bs.sync_with_mesh(mesh)
# renderer reads: bs.weights_vector(mesh)

# animate a blink in a script:
def on_update(self, dt):
    bs = self._entity.get_component(BlendShapes)
    w = (bs.get_weight("Blink") + dt * 2.0) % 1.0
    bs.set_weight("Blink", w)

weight_* fields are also exposed via get_field_value("weight_Smile") / set_field_value, and serialized as the shapes list.

docs.title: Clip and Animator
docs.text: AnimationClip stores curves and events; Animation plays one clip; Animator + AnimatorController blend states by parameters.

docs.title: Properties / API
docs.text: Field / Method Default Meaning AnimationClip.name / length / loop / sample_rate New Clip / 1.0 / true / 60 Identity and timing add_curve(property_path, bone_path) — Curve for float props, also indexed by (bone, prop) add_rotation_curve(property_path, bone_path) — QuaternionCurve for rotations add_event(AnimationEvent) — time, function_name, string/float/int_parameter, sorted by time evaluate(time) / evaluate_rotation / evaluate_all — Sample props / quats / all bone curves Animation.clip / play_on_start / speed "" / true / 1.0 Single-clip player; play/stop/pause, on_start auto-plays Animator.controller / avatar / apply_root_motion / update_mode "" / "" / false / normal State-machine player set_float/int/bool/trigger, reset_trigger — Drive transitions; trigger consumed on IF condition AnimatorState: name, clip_path, speed, transitions — transition_duration 0.25, has_exit_time, exit_time, mute/solo AnimatorCondition: parameter, mode, threshold — Modes if/if_not/greater/less/equals/not_equal

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text:
1. Create a clip asset (JSON to_dict/from_dict, Unity YAML via save_unity), set length, loop, keys.
  2. Add Animation, point clip at the asset, enable play_on_start.
  3. Or add Animator, point controller at .animcontroller JSON, set default state; parameters initialize from controller defs.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.components.animation.animation_clip import AnimationClip, AnimationEvent

clip = AnimationClip(name="Bob", length=2.0)
c = clip.add_curve("position.y", bone_path="Hips")
c.add_key(0.0, 0.0)
c.add_key(1.0, 0.5)
clip.add_event(AnimationEvent(time=1.0, function_name="on_land"))
clip.save("assets/anim/bob.anim")

anim = entity.get_component_by_name("Animation")
anim.clip = "assets/anim/bob.anim"
anim.play()
boss = entity.get_component_by_name("Animator")
boss.set_float("Speed", 2.5)
boss.set_trigger("Attack")

docs.title: Animator Controller Guide
docs.text: State machine asset: parameters drive conditional transitions between clip states. One controller holds parameters + layers; each layer holds states; each state holds transitions.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: Item Default Notes AnimatorParameter name="NewParam", type FLOAT, default_float=0.0 / default_int=0 / default_bool=False Types: float / int / bool / trigger AnimatorCondition parameter="", mode IF, threshold=0.0 Modes: if / if_not / greater / less / equals / not_equal AnimatorTransition.destination_state "" Target state name transition_duration 0.25 Blend length; has_fixed_duration=True by default has_exit_time / exit_time / offset False / 0.0 / 0.0 Exit-time gating + start offset mute / solo False / False mute disables, solo isolates the transition AnimatorState name="New State", speed=1.0, motion_time=0.0, tag="", x/y=0.0 clip or clip_path AnimatorControllerLayer name="Base Layer", weight=1.0, blending_mode="override" default_state=""

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.components.animation.animator_controller import (
    AnimatorController, AnimatorParameter, AnimatorParameterType,
    AnimatorState, AnimatorTransition, AnimatorCondition, AnimatorConditionMode,
)

ctrl = AnimatorController("Player")
ctrl.add_parameter(AnimatorParameter("Speed", AnimatorParameterType.FLOAT))
ctrl.add_parameter(AnimatorParameter("Jump", AnimatorParameterType.TRIGGER))

idle = ctrl.add_state(0, AnimatorState(name="Idle", clip_path="assets/idle.anim"))
run = ctrl.add_state(0, AnimatorState(name="Run", clip_path="assets/run.anim"))
ctrl.layers[0].default_state = "Idle"

idle.transitions.append(AnimatorTransition(
    destination_state="Run",
    conditions=[AnimatorCondition("Speed", AnimatorConditionMode.GREATER, 0.5)],
    transition_duration=0.25,
))
run.transitions.append(AnimatorTransition(
    destination_state="Idle",
    conditions=[AnimatorCondition("Speed", AnimatorConditionMode.LESS, 0.5)],
    transition_duration=0.25,
))
air = AnimatorTransition(destination_state="Run", transition_duration=0.1)
air.mute = False
air.solo = False  # set True to debug this transition in isolation
ctrl.save("assets/player.controller.json")
loaded = AnimatorController.load("assets/player.controller.json")

IF conditions check truthiness of bool/non-zero params; GREATER/LESS/EQUALS/NOT_EQUAL compare against threshold. load() also accepts Unity YAML (%YAML / %TAG / --- !u! header) via the Unity importer, otherwise JSON.

docs.title: IK and Blendshapes
docs.text: Two code-verified IK solvers pose bone chains toward targets; blendshape deltas arrive from the Assimp importer.

docs.title: Properties / API
docs.text: Item Source Meaning _IKBase.target_entity_id / target_position ikp/ccd.py Target entity or fallback Vec3 _IKBase.pole_entity_id / pole_position ikp/ccd.py Pole (elbow/knee hint) entity or Vec3 _IKBase.weight ikp/ccd.py 0–1 solver influence TwoBoneIK ikp/ccd.py Two-bone analytic/CCD solver (_IK_TYPES member) FABRIKChain.root_bone / bones / chain_length ikp/fabrik.py Chain definition; empty bones walks children of root_bone FABRIKChain.iterations / tolerance / bone_weights ikp/fabrik.py Defaults 8 / 1e-4 / per-bone weights blendshape_names / indices / positions / normals core/assets/importer/ctypes_types.py (MeshImportData), anim.py:_finalize_blendshapes Per-aiAnimMesh deltas, capped sanity 10000 meshes .import: blendshapes core/assets/importer/settings.py Default true; skeleton_ctx.want_blend gate

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text:
1. Add TwoBoneIK (limbs) or FABRIKChain (tails, spines) to the chain owner.
  2. Set root_bone + bones (or chain_length), assign target/pole entities, tune weight, iterations.
  3. For faces: import model with .import blendshapes: true; mesh carries blendshape_* arrays for the skinned renderer.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
ik = entity.get_component_by_name("FABRIKChain")
ik.root_bone = "Hips/Spine"
ik.chain_length = 3
ik.iterations = 8
ik.weight = 1.0
ik.target_entity_id = hand_target.id

docs.title: IK Guide
docs.text: Two solvers, both in core/components/animation/ikp/: analytic two-bone and iterative FABRIK. Attach one IK component per limb, point it at a target, and the chain bends each frame.

docs.title: Solvers
docs.text:
Solver Fields Notes TwoBoneIK root_bone / mid_bone / tip_bone (paths), target_entity_id or target_position, pole_entity_id or pole_position, bend_positive=True, stretch=0.0, weight=1.0 Analytic: root rotates toward the pole side (or bend_positive side), mid aims at target. Missing mid/tip falls back to first child FABRIKChain root_bone, bones[] (paths) or chain_length walk down first children, iterations=8, tolerance=1e-4, bone_weights[], same target/pole/weight fields Iterative forward/backward pass; _apply_fabrik_py blends by weight and per-bone bone_weights

Shared _IKBase: target_entity_id / target_position, pole_entity_id / pole_position, weight (ccd.py:44-50); _target_world() prefers the entity transform over the raw position.

docs.title: Update order
docs.text: Scene.update partitions components (query.py:108-132, scene.py:353-354): constraints → others → IK (run_update, query.py:135-205). IK runs last so it poses bones after constraints and regular components. Both solvers first try core._ik.batch_update_ik and fall back to pure Python (_solve_python) on ImportError.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
# Leg: hip -> knee -> foot, pole in front of the knee
from core.components.animation.ikp.ccd import TwoBoneIK

ik = TwoBoneIK()
ik.root_bone = "Hips/LeftUpLeg"
ik.mid_bone = "Hips/LeftUpLeg/LeftLeg"
ik.tip_bone = "Hips/LeftUpLeg/LeftLeg/LeftFoot"
ik.target_entity_id = foot_target.id
ik.pole_entity_id = knee_pole.id
ik.bend_positive = True
ik.weight = 1.0
entity.add_component(ik)

# Arm with FABRIK over an explicit chain
from core.components.animation.ikp.fabrik import FABRIKChain

fab = FABRIKChain()
fab.root_bone = "Spine/Shoulder"
fab.bones = ["Spine/Shoulder", "Spine/Shoulder/Elbow", "Spine/Shoulder/Elbow/Hand"]
fab.iterations = 8
fab.tolerance = 1e-4
fab.target_entity_id = hand_target.id
fab.weight = 1.0
entity.add_component(fab)

docs.title: CLI Reference
docs.text:
Entry points and flags: main.py (editor), player.py (runtime), build_nuitka.py (thin wrapper over tools/nuitka/), tools/*.py scripts.

Home

docs.title: main.py — editor entry
docs.text:
python main.py [file]
  • file (positional, optional, main.py:196): scene file to open. When it ends with .zpes, the path is first offered to a running editor instance via send_file_to_running_instance(args.file) over TCP IPC; on success the new process exits (main.py:198-202). After boot, an existing .zpes path opens via open_scene_by_path, an existing .zterr path loads into the terrain editor (main.py:279-287).
  • IPC: editor/ipc_server.py — IpcServer.try_bind() listens on (IPC_HOST, IPC_PORT) from editor/constants.py (ipc_server.py:25-37); send_file_to_running_instance() connects with 3 s timeout, sends struct.pack("!I", len) + {"file": abspath} JSON (ipc_server.py:71-81). Editor registers _open_file_from_ipc → QTimer.singleShot(0, open_scene_by_path) (main.py:269-276).
  • Startup also: _apply_python_optimization() re-exec (main.py:20-76), Wayland→XCB fallback (main.py:163-177), GL 4.6 Core + vsync swap interval (main.py:206-213), splash extension build (setup.py build_ext --inplace, main.py:110-159), plugin load from plugins/ or BuildSettings.json:build_plugins (main.py:234-252).

docs.title: player.py — runtime entry
docs.text:
python player.py [scene.zpes]
  • Scene resolution _resolve_startup_scene(project_root) (player.py:58-114), in order: (1) CLI sys.argv[1] if the path exists (player.py:62-66); (2) BuildSettings.json:scenes[0], stripping scenes/ prefix, joined under <root>/scenes/ (player.py:68-90); (3) ProjectSettings.json:project.default_scene, relative to project root (player.py:92-107); (4) <root>/scenes/SampleScene.zpes (DEFAULT_SCENE, player.py:25), else the bare "SampleScene.zpes" string (player.py:110-114). Project root is deduced by walking up to 5 levels for ProjectSettings.json/BuildSettings.json markers, else /assets/ or /scenes/ split (player.py:117-139).
  • Plugin staging: _collect_plugin_jobs() scans plugins.* packages (player.py:155-184); _split_deferred() defers example_plugin, mesh_editor_plugin, network_plugin, physics_drag_plugin, physics_visualisation_plugin, plotter_plugin, zarin_mcp (player.py:142-150,187-196); physics module plugins.physics_plugin loads on a background thread _start_physics_load (player.py:199-209); deferred modules load on QTimer.singleShot(0, _load_deferred) with on_scene_loaded / on_viewport_ready / on_play_start hooks (player.py:212-254,409-410).
  • Diagnostics: _log() prints + appends player_diag.txt at repo root (player.py:30-42); unhandled exceptions go to Logger + player_diag.txt, bug hooks installed (player.py:45-55); GL 4.6 Core, vsync from global config (player.py:268-275).

docs.title: build_nuitka.py — build wrapper
docs.text:
python build_nuitka.py [--editor] [--output-dir DIR] [--no-console] [--onefile]
  [--strip-unused | --no-strip-unused] [--no-winrt] [--compiler auto|mingw|msvc]
  [--physics culverin|pybullet|physx]

All flags are owned by tools/nuitka/config.py:19-45 (argparse, parse_known_args); build_nuitka.py only re-exports and calls build(). ENTRY = main.py with --editor, else player.py; default OUTPUT_DIR=build_output/ (config.py:36-37). Physics solver: --physics flag, else ProjectSettings.json:physics.solver normalized, fallback culverin (config.py:50-69). Compiler: --compiler auto → MinGW-w64 auto-download via tools/mingwpm, msvc forces Visual Studio (config.py:72-88). Included scenes come from BuildSettings.json:scenes with the same scenes/-prefix strip and missing-scene warning (config.py:99-117). tools/nuitka/build.py:build() compiles, with _minify_pil/_restore_pil around the run (keeps 5 PIL plugins: Bmp, Gif, Jpeg, Ppm, Png). Asset bundling helpers live in tools/nuitka/assets.py (_scan_scene_assets, _resolve_one/_resolve_assets, _collect_asset_dirs, _plugin_include_options, _rmtree_robust).

Complete key/default map for get_global_config() (18 groups) and get_project_config() (5 groups). Global file: ~/.zarin/settings.json; per-project file: <project>/ProjectSettings.json.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Config(path, defaults) (core/config/config.py:14) deep-merges JSON over defaults. get uses dot-notation with caller default on any missing segment (config.py:35-43); set creates intermediate dicts and notifies on_changed unless notify=False (config.py:44-53); reset(key) restores one key from defaults, reset() restores the whole dict (config.py:56-59). Deprecated flat color keys (ambient_r, clear_r, bg_*, tri_*, wire_*, sky_*, …) are stripped on load (config.py:102-136). Global config explicitly drops any physics group (config.py:312).

Flamegraph SVG export is external: tools/profile_flamegraph.bat / profile_svg.bat run py-spy record -o *.svg --subprocesses -- python main.py; profile_top.bat runs py-spy top --subprocesses.

docs.title: Frame pacing
docs.text: rendering.vsync (global default True) → QSurfaceFormat.setSwapInterval(0/1) in both main.py:210-213 and player.py:272-275. rendering.tick_rate=120.0 / fixed_tick_rate=60.0 drive GameWorker update/fixed rates (core/engine/eng/engine.py:395-399); engine.fixed_update_dt=0.02 is the fixed step (Engine clamps to >= 0.001); engine.time_scale=1.0 scales logic time; MAX_FIXED_STEPS=5 caps catch-up (core/config/constants.py:12). rendering.target_fps=60, viewport.update_interval=16, viewport.overlay_fps=60, play_viewport_throttle="editor" + play_viewport_throttle_step=2 (global rendering defaults, config.py:180-200).

docs.title: Geometry / shading cost
docs.text:
• Water: mesh_resolution=128.0 (slider 2–400), detail_octaves=6.0 (slider 1–12), detail_scale=1.0, detail_fade=350.0 (core/components/rendering/environment/waterp/component.py:70-74,120-125); _DetailOctaves is pushed to the shader as an int uniform (waterp/surfacing.py:156).
  • Volumetric smoke postfx: _base_octaves=4, _ridge_octaves=3, _detail_octaves=2 (each clamped 1–8 in vsmoke/rendering.py:70-74; inspector 1–8, vsmoke/inspector.py:21-23).
  • Terrain graph FBM nodes: octaves default 9, range 1–16 (editor/terrain_graph/nodesp/generators.py:16,37,59); CPU default octaves: 9 (core/terrain/terrain_generator.py:24); wind gusts _fbm1d(t, octaves=4), gust_octaves=4 (1–6, wind_zone.py:16-70).
  • Shadows: DirectionalShadow._shadow_resolution=4096, SpotShadow=1024, PointShadow=512, AreaShadow=512 (each …/environment/*_shadow.py:31-47); project rendering.shadow_distance=50.0; global rendering.max_lights=8, light_scale=1.0. Atmosphere LUT: _resolution_scale=1.0 (0.25–1.0, atmosp/component.py:23,44), max(8, int(base*scale)) in atmosp/compute.py:145; RadianceCascadesGI._resolution_scale=0.5 with quarter-res targets (radiance/component.py:36-47, radiance/resources.py:57-58); DynamicCubemaps.resolution=128 (32–512, dynacube/component.py:24,33).

docs.title: Audio budget
docs.text: Global audio.max_sources=32, stream_buffer_size=4096 (config.py:281-299); project audio mirrors volumes + priority_threshold=0.1, doppler_factor=1.0, speed_of_sound=343.3 (config.py:383-396). DSP hot paths are Cython: push_samples / mix_add / extract_last / analyze_spectrum (core/pyx/_audio_dsp.pyx:85-145, built as core._audio_dsp_cy).

docs.title: Threading
docs.text: Project physics.simulation_mode="multi_threaded" default; solver culverin with culverin_max_bodies=65536, culverin_max_pairs=65536, culverin_max_contact_constraints=65536, culverin_temp_allocator_size=16777216, culverin_max_physics_jobs=0, culverin_max_physics_barriers=0, culverin_num_threads=0 (0 = auto), culverin_enable_ccd=False, culverin_enable_sleeping=True (config.py:352-381). Mesh OBJ fast path threads: _OBJ_FAST_THREADS (importer/settings.py:25); in-memory mesh cache holds 12 entries (_MEM_CACHE_MAX=12, settings.py:23); texture settings cache holds 1024 entries (texture_import_settings.py:100-103). Cython build parallelizes over os.cpu_count() or 4 (build_cython.py:148).

docs.title: Native acceleration (Cython)
docs.text: 33 extensions in core/build_cython.py:96-130 (EXTENSIONS), compiler directives boundscheck=False, wraparound=False, cdivision=True, infer_types=True (build_cython.py:136-147); MinGW flags -O2 -DNDEBUG -march=x86-64 -mtune=generic, MSVC /O2 /fp:fast /arch:AVX2 /GL /DNDEBUG, Linux -O3 -ffast-math -march=native -DNDEBUG -flto -fopenmp (build_cython.py:65-83). GPU upload convention is float32: frustum planes, gizmo/instance buffers, skinning/transform/culling uploads all use np.float32 / .astype(np.float32) (e.g. renderer/culling.py:28-29, renderer/gpu_skinning.py:62-66, renderer/gpu_transform.py:54-56). Math in core/spatial/core/maths is numpy float64 per ARCHITECTURE.md.

docs.title: ProjectSettings.json (per project root)
docs.text:
Read by get_project_config(project_path) (core/config/config.py:318-321) and by the player fallback (player.py:92-107: project.default_scene). Full default shape (5 groups, config.py:322-397):

{

  "input": { "control_scheme": "fps", "horizontal": "a,d", "vertical": "w,s",

(Only headline keys shown; complete key lists are in Config Reference.)

docs.title: BuildSettings.json (repo/project root)
docs.text:
Read by editor startup (main.py:235-243: build_plugins), player startup (player.py:312-320: build_plugins; player.py:68-90: scenes[0] as scene fallback #2), and the Nuitka build (_load_build_settings, _get_included_scenes, tools/nuitka/config.py:91-117). Shape:

{
  "scenes": ["scenes/Main.zpes"],
  "build_plugins": ["physics_plugin"],
  "build_options": { "strip_unused_assets": true }
}

scenes[] entries may carry a scenes/ prefix (stripped on resolve); missing files produce "WARNING: scene not found". build_options.strip_unused_assets defaults True, overridable by --strip-unused / --no-strip-unused (tools/nuitka/build.py:build()).

docs.text:
Checked-in example at repo root (_build_BuildSettings.json):

{

    "example_plugin", "mesh_editor_plugin", "network_plugin",
    "physics_drag_plugin", "physics_plugin", "tracker_music_plugin",

docs.title: *.import sidecars (per asset)
docs.text:
Resolution: mesh path + ".import" with project-root candidate search (core/assets/importer/settings.py:41-54); texture path + ".import" with 2 s mtime cache + 1024-entry settings cache (texture_import_settings.py:18-20,63-106); audio path + ".import" (clip.py:151-158, system.py:170-175). Mesh defaults (settings.py:67-77):

{
  "scale": 1.0, "center_pivot": false, "flip_uvs": true,
  "smooth_angle": 30.0, "gen_normals": true, "gen_uvs": true,
  "blendshapes": true, "materials": ["mat0"]
}

Texture defaults (texture_import_settings.py:42-49):

{
  "filter_mode": "trilinear", "anisotropic": 1, "max_size": 2048,
  "wrap_mode": "clamp", "compression": "none", "srgb": true
}

Enums in code: FilterMode = point|bilinear|trilinear, WrapMode = repeat|clamp|mirrored_repeat, CompressionQuality = none|low|normal|high (texture_import_settings.py:23-40). Audio sidecar: only key read is quality (int → resample target percent; >= 100 = no-op, floor 8000 Hz — clip.py:149-169,190-199); unsupported extensions raise ValueError("Unsupported audio format: …") (clip.py:160-161).

Corrupt file → warning + compiled defaults (config.py:93-101); delete the file to reset. Full 18-group map: Config Reference.

docs.title: Scene Schema (.zpes)
docs.text:
JSON layout of a saved scene: entity dicts, component dicts, and the backup/rotation + shadow-system conventions. All keys below are the literal serialize() output.

Home

docs.title: File envelope
docs.text: Atomic write: JSON (indent=2) → <scene>.build temp → os.replace (core/engine/eng/scenes.py:55-59). Before every save, backups rotate with _SCENE_BACKUP_KEEP = 2 (scenes.py:20-52): *.bak2 older than keep deleted, *.bak → *.bak2, current file → *.bak. So Scene.zpes.bak is the newest generation, Scene.zpes.bak2 one older. Resource embedding runs before persist (_embed_scene_resources, scenes.py:63-70); paths relativized via PATH_FIELDS (mesh_path, material_path, clip_path, script_path, texture_path, ply_path, shader_path, env_path, svg_path, font_path, video_path, graph_path, skybox_path — core/config/constants.py:14-18).

docs.title: Entity dict (core/ecs/entity.py:408-426)
docs.text:
Always present: id, name, active, tags (list), layer (int), parent (parent id or None), components (list; each entry is the component dict plus _key). Optional, only when set: prefab_guid, prefab_source_id, embed_resources: True, locked: True, system: True. Deserialize mirrors every key with defaults active=True, tags=[], layer=0 (entity.py:428-445).

{
  "id": "…", "name": "Shadow System", "active": true, "tags": [], "layer": 0,
  "parent": null, "locked": true, "system": true,
  "components": [{ "type": "Transform", "_key": "Transform", "enabled": true }]
}

docs.title: Component dicts (selected)
docs.text:
Base Component.serialize() contributes type + enabled (see core/ecs/component.py:192). Examples:

  • ScriptComponent (core/components/scripting/scriptc/component.py:132-150): adds script_path (str) + script_fields (dict; Vec2/3/4 → lists, Enum → value, Curve → to_dict(), else raw). Deserialize restores Curve from any dict with keys (component.py:153-168).
  • Rigidbody (core/components/physics/rigidbody.py:76-98): mass=1.0, drag=0.0, angular_drag=0.05, use_gravity=True, is_kinematic=False, freeze_pos=[x,y,z], freeze_rot=[x,y,z] bools.
  • Shadows (…/environment/directional_shadow.py:76-89, spot_shadow.py:39-47, point_shadow.py:39-47, area_shadow.py:39-47): _shadow_resolution (4096 / 1024 / 512 / 512).
  • TooltipComponent (controls/tooltip_component.py:59-72): text="", _duration=0.0, _rich_text=True.
  • Water (waterp/component.py:136+): material_path, surface_type, infinite_ocean, ocean_size, waves[], deep_color, …, mesh_resolution, detail_octaves, …

docs.title: Shadow System entity
docs.text: Engine._ensure_shadow_system (core/engine/eng/engine.py:354-379, also called from eng/scenes.py:160,229,352,378): if no DirectionalShadow entity exists in the scene, creates entity "Shadow System" with Transform + DirectionalShadow + PointShadow + SpotShadow + AreaShadow, flags system=True, locked=True. Locked/system entities are skipped by viewport picking (viewport_camera.py:106) and hierarchy DnD (panels/hierarchy/dnd.py:167).

docs.title: Style Guide (Contribution Contract)
docs.text:
Enforced by py tools/arch_gate.py. Source: ARCHITECTURE.md + tools/arch_gate.py.

Home

docs.title: Layers (dependencies only downward)
docs.text:
main.py / player.py            entry points
editor/                        editor (PySide6): panels, viewport, inspector
plugins/                       plugins (VR, physics, tracker, plotter, MCP)
core/components/               ECS components (data + serialization)
core/renderer/ core/physics/
core/audio/ core/network/      subsystems (logic, no Qt)
core/ecs/                      Entity / Component / Scene / ComponentRegistry
core/foundation/               logger, config, commands, profiler, plugins
core/spatial/ core/maths/      math and data structures (numpy float64)

core/ never imports editor or plugins; upward communication only via Engine.on/emit events and callbacks (ARCHITECTURE.md:19).

docs.title: Modules
docs.text:
• One file = one responsibility, ≤ 450 lines, one public class (+ private helpers). Exception: editor/panels/project/* up to 500 lines — allowlist ALLOW_BIG (arch_gate.py:25-35,39): panel.py, pane.py, widgets.py, fs_ops.py + vendored plugins/tracker_music_plugin/libs/nodmod/{xmsong,modsong,song,s3msong,types}.py.
  • Package assembly via mixins: component.py (skeleton) + solver.py/draw.py/… + __init__.py with re-export (ARCHITECTURE.md:25).
  • Public API only through the package __init__.py; package internals are private. Canonical examples (ARCHITECTURE.md:27-30): from core.ecs import Component, Entity, Scene, ComponentRegistry; from core.components.transform.tr import Transform; from editor.panels.project import ProjectPanel. The gate resolves top-level imports against core/editor/plugins/physics_solvers/tools/tests/playerp/nodmod/main/player plus EXTENSION_SUFFIXES (arch_gate.py:250-274).

docs.title: Components
docs.text:
• Inherit Component; @ComponentRegistry.register is mandatory or the component is invisible (gate checks every Component subclass except *Mixin*, *Base*, _private, plus ALLOW_UNREGISTERED = {"SkyIbl", "RaytraceComponent"} — arch_gate.py:277-306).
  • Serialization pair serialize/deserialize; inspector via _inspector_fields.
  • Lifecycle: on_awake → on_start → on_update(dt) / on_fixed_update(dt) → on_destroy (ARCHITECTURE.md:36).

docs.title: Code style
docs.text:
• License header is the first line. No comments; docstrings only where the contract is unclear without one (ARCHITECTURE.md:40). Gate: check_comments flags any # comment after code starts; check_docstrings flags module/class/function string-literal first statements (arch_gate.py:88-120). Exempt: main.py/player.py, vendored libs/nodmod, tests (ARCHITECTURE.md:42).
  • Colors/shaders without # in source — use chr(35), rgb(); runtime values stay 1:1 (ARCHITECTURE.md:41, e.g. menup/builder.py:33 _qta = lambda n, c=chr(35)+"d4d4d4": …).
  • Gate also checks: py_compile of every .py (excluding .venv/__pycache__/NodeGraphQt/.git/build/dist/linux/~), file size, undefined names (allowing __compiled__), and import resolvability (arch_gate.py:42-51,123-274).

docs.title: Verification
docs.text:
py tools/arch_gate.py            # compile, comments, docstrings, size, names, imports, registry
py tools/arch_gate.py --smoke    # gate + whole tests/smoke suite
py tests/smoke/run_smokes.py     # full suite standalone (fresh process per test, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen)

Gate prints GATE OK/GATE FAIL (arch_gate.py:348); --smoke tolerates only KNOWN_SMOKE_FAILS = {"test_compression_async.py", "test_prop_picker.py"} (arch_gate.py:38). Pre-existing, non-regression causes (ARCHITECTURE.md:52-54): test_compression_async.py — 150 KB budget unachievable at fast level (minimum 159 KB); test_prop_picker.py — the .anim clip has no position curves, so waiting for y=0.1413 has nothing to fire on.

docs.text: file what it drives test_blendshapes.py Synthetic MeshData + BlendShapes deform path (imports core.renderer.meshd, blendshapes) test_compression_async.py Async scene resource compression vs 150 KB fast-level budget — known fail (minimum 159 KB, ARCHITECTURE.md:52-53) test_digest_dedup.py Embed digest/dedup (core.ecs.embed) round-trip in a temp dir test_duplicate_skinned.py Skinned-mesh duplication (Transform, skinned_factory, armature) test_embed2.py embed_scene_resources / extract_embedded_resources with .bak file moves test_embed_outside.py Embed with resources outside project root (_storage_key, _iter_component_path_entries) test_engine_embed.py Full Engine + MeshFilter embed flow with .bak moves test_ik_numeric.py Numerics of two_bone_flat / fabrik_flat from core._ik test_import_materials.py MeshRenderer + asset material import pipeline test_mesh_import_persist.py quad.obj mesh import persistence under a temp proj/assets/meshes root test_prop_picker.py Prop-picker against an .anim clip — known fail (no position curves, y=0.1413 never fires, ARCHITECTURE.md:54) test_relpaths.py Relative-path handling for quad.obj + materials under temp proj/ test_script_cython.py User-script Cython companion build (cythonp, ScriptComponent) in temp dir test_script_inspector.py Script inspector widgets offscreen (QApplication, QPushButton/QLineEdit/QSlider) test_scripting.py Engine + Scene + ScriptComponent script lifecycle test_soft_remote.py Headless soft-body round-trip in the separate physics process

docs.title: Runners
docs.text:
• tests/smoke/run_smokes.py — iterates SMOKE_DIR.glob("test_*.py") sorted, subprocess.run([PYTHON, script], cwd=ROOT, PYTHONPATH=ROOT, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen), prints == name / PASS / FAIL (exit N), summary FAILED: … or ALL N SMOKE TESTS PASSED, exit 1/0 (run_smokes.py:19-38). Launch: py tests/smoke/run_smokes.py.
  • tools/arch_gate.py --smoke — same suite via run_smokes() subprocess, parses FAILED: lines, tolerates only KNOWN_SMOKE_FAILS = {"test_compression_async.py", "test_prop_picker.py"} (arch_gate.py:309-318,340-346).
  • tests/libs/test_library_packs.py — library-pack suite (zplug packs; imports json/os/sys/tempfile at head). Launch: python tests/libs/test_library_packs.py.

docs.title: Adding your own test
docs.text:
1. Create tests/smoke/test_<name>.py as a standalone script: insert repo root on sys.path (copy the sys.path.insert(0, r"…ZarinEngine") preamble), guard Qt with os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen") before QApplication.
  2. Exit 0 on success, non-zero on failure — the runner only checks returncode (run_smokes.py:27-33).
  3. Keep engine-touching tests hermetic: use tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=…) project roots like test_mesh_import_persist.py / test_relpaths.py; move fixtures to *.bak (not delete) if you need restore, mirroring test_engine_embed.py:67-70.
  4. New files under tests/ are skipped by the arch gate's style scope (arch_gate.py:72) but still run under --smoke; if your test fails for a pre-existing reason, do not extend KNOWN_SMOKE_FAILS without updating ARCHITECTURE.md:52-54.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Fixes for failures whose cause is visible in code. Only code-backed remedies — no speculation.

Home

docs.title: Wayland session renders nothing / window invisible
docs.text: main.py:163-177: when XDG_SESSION_TYPE contains wayland and QT_QPA_PLATFORM is unset, the editor forces QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb + QT_XCB_GL_INTEGRATION=glx ("Falling back to XCB for OpenGL compatibility"). If QT_QPA_PLATFORM=wayland is set explicitly, it prints that Qt6+OpenGL on Wayland "may cause window visibility issues". Fix: unset QT_QPA_PLATFORM (let the fallback trigger) or export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb yourself. Only what the code does — no compositor advice.

docs.title: Native extensions missing or stale (.pyx newer than .pyd)
docs.text: main.py:78-108 (_check_extensions_missing, skipped when frozen): 25 tracked module names under core/ are compared against core/pyx/*.pyx mtimes — any missing .pyd/stale source returns True. The splash builder then runs python setup.py build_ext --inplace (main.py:117-159, progress over total_exts = 25). Fix: run python setup.py build_ext --inplace manually (add --compiler=msvc or ZARIN_COMPILER=msvc to force MSVC instead of auto-downloaded MinGW-w64; see core/build_cython.py:18-63). If the build fails, the splash reports "Extension build failed (exit code …)" and startup continues without natives.

docs.title: Audio silent — "OpenAL not available"
docs.text: core/audio/sys/system.py:64-66: when the openal import failed at module load (system.py:13-17), init logs a warning "OpenAL not available, audio disabled" and runs without sound. core/audio/efx/efx.py:15,197-203 and filters.py:28, slots.py:78-82 raise EFXError("EFX not available") / "Failed to create …" when OpenAL/EFX is absent. Fix per code: install the OpenAL runtime + pip install openal bindings; EFX paths require a working EFX context (ensure_efx). Non-WAV formats additionally need miniaudio (clip.py:164-167: "miniaudio not available; cannot load …").

docs.title: Model import fails — "Assimp library not found"
docs.text: core/assets/importer/assimp.py:16-19,31-56: the loader looks for assimp-vc143-mt.dll (win32, repo root) or libassimp.so.6.0.5 (other OS), falling back to the bare library name on PATH; both binaries are shipped at repo root. On failure _get_dll() raises RuntimeError("Assimp library not found"). Fix: restore the shipped DLL/SO next to the project root (path = _find_project_root() walking up to the core/ parent) or install Assimp on the loader path.

docs.title: Nuitka build fails
docs.text: tools/nuitka/build.py:build() prints Python:, Root:, resolves scenes via _get_included_scenes (missing scene → "WARNING: scene not found", config.py:116), resolves compiler via tools/mingwpm ("WARNING: MinGW-w64 auto-download failed … Falling back to Nuitka's own toolchain download", config.py:86-87), and minifies PIL around the run (_minify_pil keeps Bmp/Gif/Jpeg/Ppm/Png, restores afterwards). Fix per code: retry with --compiler msvc (Visual Studio toolchain) or --compiler mingw (compact MinGW-w64); pass --no-strip-unused if scene-asset scanning dropped something you need; check BuildSettings.json:scenes paths exist.

docs.title: Black viewport (no GL context)
docs.text: main.py:206-209 and player.py:268-271 request QSurfaceFormat: depth 24, OpenGL 4.6 CoreProfile, swap interval from rendering.vsync. A black viewport with no exception means context creation failed on the driver side. Fix per code: verify a GL 4.6-capable driver is active (the format is non-negotiable in code); toggle rendering.vsync in ~/.zarin/settings.json to rule out swap-interval issues.

docs.title: Settings corrupted — reset to defaults
docs.text: Global file is ~/.zarin/settings.json (core/config/config.py:142); project file is <project>/ProjectSettings.json (config.py:321). Config.save() writes pretty JSON (indent=2); a corrupt file logs "Failed to load config …" and falls back to compiled defaults (config.py:93-101). Fix: delete (or rename) ~/.zarin/settings.json and restart — defaults from get_global_config() are re-applied; per-project, delete ProjectSettings.json similarly. Restart-marked keys (theme, font/ui scale, language, engine.python_*) only apply on next launch anyway.

docs.title: Scene file damaged — .bak rotation
docs.text: core/engine/eng/scenes.py:20-52: every scene save rotates backups with _SCENE_BACKUP_KEEP = 2 — previous .bak → .bak2, .bak2 older than keep is deleted, current file copied to .bak (shutil.copyfile, atomic write via .build temp, scenes.py:55-59). Fix: restore Scene.zpes from Scene.zpes.bak (newest) or Scene.zpes.bak2 (one generation older).

docs.title: AudioListener
docs.text:
The ears of the scene. Attach to the camera entity; the listener Transform defines what the player hears and from where.

Field Default Inspector range Meaning doppler_factor 1.0 0–10 Pitch shift from relative motion speed_of_sound 343.3 0.1–10000 m/s reference for doppler math

Per-frame behavior, verified from code:

  • on_start pushes both values into AudioSystem once.
  • on_update re-pushes both values, then sets listener position from the Transform, orientation from Transform forward/up, and velocity as the finite position difference over dt (zero on the first frame).
  • Both fields serialize into the scene (doppler_factor, speed_of_sound) with the same defaults on load.

Guidance:

  • Exactly one active listener per scene. Two listeners fight over the singleton state every frame.
  • Parent the listener to the player camera so rotation affects panning and doppler follows movement.
  • Exaggerate doppler_factor (2–4) for arcade fly-bys; keep 1.0 for realism. Underwater scenes lower speed_of_sound toward ~1480 for water.
  • Sources with spatial_blend 0 ignore the listener position; blend 1 sources pan and attenuate fully.

Related: AudioSource, Audio System, Camera.

docs.title: AudioSource
docs.text:
A playable voice on an entity: clip, loudness, pitch, looping, 3D position, distance falloff, fades and finish callbacks.

Inspector group / field Default Meaning Playback: Clip — Audio file (wav/mp3/ogg/flac) Playback: Volume 1.0 Loudness multiplier Playback: Pitch 1.0 Playback rate, −3…3 Playback: Loop off Restart at the end Playback: Play On Awake off Auto-start in on_start Spatial: Spatial Blend 1.0 0 = flat 2D, 1 = full 3D Spatial: Zone Shape sphere SPHERE or BOX attenuation volume Spatial: Volume Rolloff linear Curve editor, default keys [[0,1],[1,0]] Spatial: Min / Max Distance 1.0 / 50.0 Full-volume radius and silence radius Spatial: Box Inner / Outer Size 2³ / 10³ BOX zone full-volume and falloff extents Fades: Offset (sec) 0.0 Start position inside the clip Fades: Fade In / Fade Out Time 0.0 Automatic ramps on play / stop

Lifecycle, verified from code:

  • on_start plays when play_on_awake is set, a clip is assigned and nothing is playing.
  • on_enable replays the clip whenever the component is enabled with a clip assigned.
  • on_disable / on_destroy stop the native source immediately.
  • on_update advances active fades, polls AL_SOURCE_STATE, restarts looped clips, and fires on_finished (natural end) or on_stopped (stopped, fade-out completed). Callback exceptions are logged, never thrown.

Script API:

src = self._entity.get_component_by_name("AudioSource")

def on_start(self):
    src = self._entity.get_component_by_name("AudioSource")
    if src:
        src.on_finished = self.next_track
        src.play()

def next_track(self):
    src = self._entity.get_component_by_name("AudioSource")
    if src:
        src.stop()

def on_update(self, dt):
    src = self._entity.get_component_by_name("AudioSource")
    if src and Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.M):
        if src.is_playing:
            src.stop()
        else:
            src.play()

Details:

  • play() is a no-op without a clip or while already playing; it forwards volume, pitch, loop, spatial blend, distances, rolloff, offset and zone shape to the manager and arms fade_in_time through a zero-gain start.
  • stop() with fade_out_time set performs a fade-out first and only then releases the source; without it the source stops immediately. fade_in(duration) / fade_out(duration) are also callable directly.
  • is_playing reflects the component state flag.
  • Rolloff presets: linear_preset() returns [[0,1],[1,0]]; logarithmic_preset() builds 1/(1+2t) keys at 0.1 steps for a natural distance falloff.
  • Zone evaluation is sphere-based by default (min_distance full volume, max_distance silence); BOX mode uses inner size as full volume and outer size as the falloff boundary. The gizmo draws the active shape in the viewport.

Troubleshooting: no sound → check clip path resolves, AudioSystem exists (openal installed), listener present, volume and spatial blend nonzero, listener within max distance; clicks on stop → set a small fade_out_time; loop gap → keep loop on and avoid re-calling play every frame.

Related: AudioListener, Reverb Zone, Audio System, Curve (rolloff editor).

docs.title: Audio Overview
docs.text:
3D positional audio over OpenAL: sources live on entities, one listener acts as the ears, reverb zones color the space, and the engine services handle decoding, caching and per-frame updates.

Signal path per frame:

  1. AudioListener.on_update pushes position, orientation and velocity (finite difference of the Transform) plus doppler settings into AudioSystem.
  2. Each playing AudioSource advances fades in on_update, polls the OpenAL source state, and restarts looped clips or fires on_finished / on_stopped.
  3. AudioSourceManager owns the native source ids: play, stop, pause, loop, spatial blend, distances and rolloff curves.
  4. AudioSystem owns resources: clip loading and caching, async loads, listener state, doppler and speed of sound.
  5. ReverbZone components feed the OpenAL EFX chain (audio_efx, guarded by EFXError when the extension is missing).

Supported clip formats (decoder): .wav, .wave, .mp3, .ogg, .vorbis, .flac (AUDIO_EXTENSIONS in core/audio/miniaudio_decoder.py). The AudioSource Inspector file filter is narrower — Audio (*.wav *.mp3 *.ogg *.flac) (core/components/audio/source/component.py). Decoding is handled by the miniaudio backend into DecodedAudio buffers (decode_audio / decode_audio_stereo / decode_audio_channels); .wav/.wave also decode via stdlib wave when miniaudio is absent (core/audio/sys/clip.py).

Pages: AudioSource, AudioListener, Reverb Zone, Audio System (manager, decoders, analyzer, EFX).

Setup minimum for audible sound: one entity with AudioListener (usually the camera), one entity with AudioSource pointing at a clip, press Play. If play_on_awake is off, start playback from a script or enable the component at runtime — enabling replays the clip from the start.

docs.title: Reverb Zone
docs.text:
Spatial reverberation over OpenAL EFX: rooms, halls, caves and tunnels that color every source passing through.

Inspector group Covers Zone Min Distance (default 10.0), Max Distance (default 15.0) — full-effect and falloff radii Reverb Preset Named starting points for common spaces (default Generic; Off bypasses, User marks hand-tuned params) Room Room level (default −1000), Room HF (default −100), Room LF (default 0) — low/mid/high decay balance Decay Decay Time (default 1.49), Decay HFRatio (default 0.83) — length and brightness of the tail Reflections Reflections level (default −2602), Reflections Delay (default 0.007) — early echoes Reverb Reverb level (default 200), Reverb Delay (default 0.011) — late diffuse field Reference HFReference (default 5000), LFReference (default 250) — crossover frequencies Rolloff Room Rolloff Factor (default 0.0) — distance response of the effect Mix Diffusion (default 100.0), Density (default 100.0) — echo density / modal richness

Source: core/components/audio/reverb/component.py (_inspector_fields, __init__ defaults, serialize/deserialize with legacy linear→mB migration).

Workflow:

  1. Add the component to an empty entity marking the space center.
  2. Pick the closest preset, set Min Distance to cover the room, Max Distance to feather the edge.
  3. Tune Decay Time first (small room ~0.3 s, hall ~1.5 s, cave ~3 s), then early reflections for slap, then late level for wash.
  4. Walk the listener through with a looping source to verify the transition in and out.

The EFX path is guarded: without the extension the engine raises EFXError internally and continues dry — check the console if a zone sounds flat on some machines.

Related: AudioSource (spatial blend feeds the send), AudioListener (listener position drives zone routing), Audio System (EFX module), Fog (visual twin for caves).

docs.title: Audio System
docs.text:
Engine services behind the components: resources, decoding, per-source state and the EFX chain.

Modules (core/audio):

  • sys/system.py: AudioSystem — singleton: clip loading and caching (load_clip / load_clip_async / get_clip, cache keyed by absolute path + .import mtime), listener position/orientation/velocity setters, doppler factor and speed of sound, device enumeration. Components never touch OpenAL directly; they call here.
  • sys/sources.py: AudioSourceManager — singleton: owns native source ids and per-source state — play, stop, pause, stop_all, volume, pitch, spatial blend, distances, rolloff curves, zone shapes and box sizes; enforces audio.max_sources (default 32).
  • sys/clip.py: AudioClip — load_from_file (honors sidecar <clip>.import quality 0–100 via _resample, floor 8000 Hz), create_buffer, ensure_pcm / ensure_stereo_pcm.
  • miniaudio_decoder.DecodedAudio — decode backend turning .wav / .wave / .mp3 / .ogg / .vorbis / .flac files into PCM buffers ready for OpenAL upload.
  • audio_analyzer — analysis helpers (spectrum and level followers) for visualizers and beat-reactive effects.
  • efx/ (efx.py, filters.py, slots.py) — EFX extension wrapper for reverb zones; EFXError signals a missing extension so the engine can fall back to dry output.

Data flow for a new clip: AudioSource.play → manager play(...) with all spatial parameters → system resolves the clip from cache (load_clip) or decodes on the audio thread pool (load_clip_async callback) → native source configured (gain, pitch, looping, position, rolloff) → component polls state each frame.

Resource discipline: clips are fully decoded into PCM buffers and cached by absolute path (invalidated on .import mtime change), so ten sources sharing one file decode once; releasing the last source frees the native id (stop / stop_all) while the decoded buffer stays cached for instant replay.

Gizmo support: audio components declare the audio gizmo pass with zone shapes and distance rings, so levels can be mixed visually in the viewport.

Related: AudioSource, AudioListener, Reverb Zone, Curve, Profiler (audio_ms readout).

docs.title: Constraints Catalog
docs.text: Transform followers evaluated in Scene.update before regular components and IK (query.py:135-205). All ten classes are exported from core/components/constraints/__init__.py:7-23. Every class has is_active, sources: [{entity_id, weight}], add_source(entity, weight=1.0), remove_source(index); offsets keep the current pose when retargeting.

docs.title: PositionConstraint
docs.text: Copies the weighted source position per axis. Fields: weight_x/y/z = 1.0, internal _offset = Vec3.zero(); set_offset_from_current_position() stores position − target so enabling the constraint does not snap the object.

docs.title: RotationConstraint
docs.text: Copies weighted source rotation per axis. Fields: weight_x/y/z = 1.0, _offset_rotation = Quat.identity(); set_offset_from_current_rotation().

docs.title: ScaleConstraint
docs.text: Copies weighted source scale. Fields: weight_x/y/z = 1.0, _offset_scale = Vec3(1,1,1); set_offset_from_current_scale().

docs.title: ParentConstraint
docs.text: Unity-style parent: position + rotation + scale with per-axis locks. Fields: constrain_position_x/y/z, constrain_rotation_x/y/z, constrain_scale_x/y/z (all True), _position_offset, _rotation_offset, _scale_offset; three set_offset_from_current_* helpers.

docs.title: MoveTowardsConstraint
docs.text: Moves toward the weighted target at constant speed. Fields: speed = 5.0, maintain_offset = False (+ internal _offset); set_offset_from_current_position().

docs.title: RotateTowardsConstraint
docs.text: Rotates toward the target at constant angular speed. Fields: speed = 90.0 deg/s.

docs.title: ScaleToConstraint
docs.text: Scales toward the target by ratio with clamping. Fields: scale_factor = 1.0, min_scale = 0.5, max_scale = 2.0.

docs.title: AimConstraint
docs.text: Aims a local axis at the target with world-up stabilization. Fields: aim_position_weight = 1.0, world_up_weight = 1.0, local_euler_axis_x = False, local_euler_axis_y = False, local_euler_axis_z = True.

docs.title: LookAtConstraint
docs.text: Look-at with up-vector blending. Fields: look_at_weight = 1.0, world_up_weight = 1.0.

docs.title: FollowTransformConstraint
docs.text: Smooth follow with separate speeds. Fields: follow_position = True, follow_rotation = True, position_speed = 10.0, rotation_speed = 90.0.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.components.constraints.position_constraint import PositionConstraint

pc = PositionConstraint()
pc.add_source(leader_entity, weight=1.0)
pc.weight_x, pc.weight_y, pc.weight_z = 1.0, 1.0, 0.0  # lock Z
entity.add_component(pc)
pc.set_offset_from_current_position()  # keep current pose, no snap
pc.is_active = False  # pause without removing
pc.remove_source(0)

docs.title: Components and Lifecycle
docs.text:
A Component is data plus lifecycle hooks. Subclass it, decorate with @ComponentRegistry.register, implement serialize/deserialize, and the engine calls on_awake → on_start → on_update(dt) / on_fixed_update(dt) → on_destroy.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Component.__init_subclass__ auto-detects per-frame participation: _updates is True when the subclass overrides on_update, _fixed_updates when it overrides on_fixed_update. Only active-entity, enabled components sit in the scene's dispatch sets; the enabled setter syncs them immediately. on_awake runs on add_component (even in edit mode); on_start runs once per Scene.start() (i.e. Play start). Scene.update partitions components into constraints → others → IK; Scene.fixed_update iterates the cached fixed set in set order (no guaranteed insertion order). Callback exceptions are caught per component and logged as Update error in <entity>/<component> (same for fixed). ScriptComponent._allow_multiple = True; most built-ins are single-instance.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: name type default description enabled bool True Setter adds/removes the component from scene dispatch sets entity Entity|None None Owning entity (set by add_component) transform Component|None cached Owning entity's Transform, cached per component _allow_multiple bool False True → key Class.<8-hex>; e.g. ScriptComponent, colliders _updates bool auto True if subclass overrides on_update _fixed_updates bool auto True if subclass overrides on_fixed_update on_awake hook pass At add_component time on_start hook pass Once per Scene.start() on_update(dt) hook pass Every frame in Play mode on_fixed_update(dt) hook pass Every fixed step in Play mode on_enable / on_disable hook pass On entity activation / deactivation on_destroy hook pass On component/entity/scene removal serialize method {"type", "enabled"} Base dict; subclasses extend gizmo hooks methods gizmo_lines, gizmo_primitives, gizmo_instances, … Editor visualization; empty by default

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text: Add Component menu is built from ComponentRegistry.all() grouped by inferred category. Inspector fields come from _inspector_fields() (InspectorField metadata). Multi-instance components show suffixed keys (ScriptComponent.ab12cd34) and an order control via Entity.move_component(key, direction).

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.ecs import Component
from core.ecs import ComponentRegistry
from core.maths.math3d import Vec3

@ComponentRegistry.register
class Mover(Component):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.speed = 5.0

    def on_update(self, dt: float):
        t = self.transform
        if t:
            t.translate(Vec3(0.0, 0.0, self.speed * dt))

    def serialize(self):
        d = super().serialize()
        d["speed"] = self.speed
        return d

    @classmethod
    def deserialize(cls, data):
        m = cls()
        m._enabled = bool(data.get("enabled", True))
        m.speed = float(data.get("speed", 5.0))
        return m

from core.components.scripting.scriptc.component import ScriptComponent

comp.enabled = False  # leaves the scene dispatch sets until re-enabled
multi = player.add_component(ScriptComponent())  # key like "ScriptComponent.<8-hex>"
player.move_component(multi._key, -1)  # reorder multi-instance components

docs.title: Serialization
docs.text: Base component dict: {"type": "<ClassName>", "enabled": true, "_key": "<key>"} (_key added by Entity.serialize). Subclasses add their fields; unknown type names are skipped on load (Entity.deserialize checks registry.get(ctype)).

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
Config is JSON-backed settings with dot-notation access (config.get("physics.gravity_y")), defaults preservation, and change listeners. Global file: ~/.zarin/settings.json; per-project: <project>/ProjectSettings.json.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Config(path, defaults) loads JSON over a defaults dict (deep merge). get returns the caller default when any path segment is missing; set creates intermediate dicts and notifies on_changed listeners unless notify=False. reset(key) restores one key from defaults (or the whole file when key=None). Keys that need a restart are flagged with mark_restart (editor.theme, editor.font_size, editor.ui_scale, editor.language, engine.python_jit, engine.python_optimize, engine.python_unbuffered, engine.python_no_bytecode). main.py reads engine.python_jit / python_optimize / python_unbuffered / python_no_bytecode before startup and re-execs the interpreter when they differ.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: name type default description get_global_config function singleton Defaults include editor, camera, profiler, rendering, gizmo, console, terminal, viewport, collab, undo, engine, hierarchy, inspector, project, plugins, audio, file_assoc, mesh_preview get_project_config function per path Defaults: project (name, version, default_scene=""), input, rendering, physics, audio engine.time_scale float 1.0 Logic time multiplier engine.fixed_update_dt float 0.02 Fixed step (Engine clamps to >= 0.001) rendering.vsync bool True Swap interval in main.py/player.py rendering.tick_rate float 120.0 GameWorker update rate rendering.fixed_tick_rate float 60.0 GameWorker fixed rate profiler.enabled bool False Enables engine.profiler physics.gravity_y float -9.81 Project default; gravity_x/z = 0.0 project.default_scene str "" Player fallback #3 get / set / has / reset / to_dict / update / save methods — Full Config API on_changed(callback) method — callback(key, value) on every notified set

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text: Settings dialog edits the global config and saves to ~/.zarin/settings.json. Restart-marked keys (theme, ui_scale, language, python_*) apply on next launch. Project settings (ProjectSettings.json) hold name, version, default scene, input bindings, physics solver parameters.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.config.config import get_global_config, get_project_config

cfg = get_global_config()
dt = cfg.get("engine.fixed_update_dt", 0.02)
cfg.set("engine.time_scale", 0.5)
cfg.on_changed(lambda key, value: print(key, value))
cfg.save()

proj = get_project_config("/path/to/project")
print(proj.get("project.default_scene", ""))

print(cfg.is_restart_key("editor.theme"))  # True: applies on next launch
cfg.reset("engine.time_scale")  # restore one key from defaults

docs.title: ECS Overview
docs.text:
ZarinEngine is an Entity-Component-System engine: Entity objects hold data, Component objects add behavior, Scene owns entities and dispatches update / fixed_update.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Layer order (dependencies point down only): main.py / player.py → editor/ → plugins/ → core/components/ → core/renderer, physics, audio, network → core/ecs/ (Entity, Component, Scene, ComponentRegistry) → core/foundation/ → core/spatial, core/maths (ARCHITECTURE.md). core/ never imports editor or plugins; upward communication is Engine.on / Engine.off listeners plus _emit_event callbacks.

Runtime dispatch: Engine.tick() (play mode only) runs up to 5 fixed steps (Scene.fixed_update(fd)) then one Scene.update(dt). Scene keeps _active_update_components / _active_fixed_components sets plus cached lists; on_update is partitioned into constraints → others → IK. Exceptions in callbacks are logged with entity and component names and never stop the frame.

docs.text: Entities are created in the Hierarchy panel; components are added via Add Component (registry categories: Transform, Rendering, Physics, Physics 2D, Lighting, Audio, Constraints, Network, Scripting). The Inspector edits fields; enabled toggles participation in updates.

from core.ecs import Component, Entity, Scene, ComponentRegistry
from core.components.transform.tr import Transform

scene = Scene("Demo")
player = scene.create_entity("Player")
player.add_component(Transform())
scene.start()          # Scene.start() -> on_start() on all components
scene.update(0.016)    # on_update(dt) on active, enabled components
scene.fixed_update(0.02)

docs.title: Entity
docs.text:
Entity is a scene object: UUID id, name, parent/children hierarchy, tags, layer, active toggle, and a typed component store.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Entity(name="Entity", eid=None, prefab_guid=None) generates a UUID when eid is omitted. Components live in _components (key → instance) plus _type_map (class → list). Single-instance components use the class name as key; _allow_multiple components get ClassName.<8-hex> keys. add_component calls comp.on_awake() immediately; remove_* call on_destroy(). Toggling active fires on_enable/on_disable on enabled components and adds/removes them from the scene's active update sets. set_parent(parent, preserve_world=True) keeps the world matrix by default.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: name type default description id str UUID4 Stable identity; scene dict key; serialized name str "Entity" Display name; get_entity_by_name matches it active bool True Inactive entities leave active update sets; on_enable/on_disable fire parent Entity|None None Hierarchy link; Scene.get_root_entities() returns parentless entities children list[Entity] [] Direct children; remove_entity recurses into them tags set[str] set() Free-form tags; serialized as list layer int 0 Integer layer; serialized transform Component|None cached Transform Fast path to the entity's Transform prefab_guid str|None None Set → is_prefab_instance is True prefab_source_id str|None None Source entity id inside the prefab embed_resources bool False Embed this entity's resources on save locked bool False Editor lock flag (e.g. Shadow System) system bool False System entity flag (e.g. Shadow System)

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text: Hierarchy panel: create, rename, delete, duplicate, drag-to-reparent, toggle active checkbox. Locked/system entities (e.g. Shadow System) resist casual edits.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.components.transform.tr import Transform

player = scene.create_entity("Player")
player.tags.add("player")
player.layer = 5
tr = player.add_component(Transform())

child = scene.create_entity("Gun")
child.set_parent(player)  # preserve_world=True by default

got = player.get_component(Transform)            # first match incl. subclasses
by_name = player.get_component_by_name("Transform")
all_tr = player.get_components(Transform)
player.remove_component(Transform)
scene.remove_entity(player.id)  # recursive over children

clone = scene.duplicate_entity(player, "PlayerCopy")  # fresh UUIDs, Armature bone ids rebound
print(player.has_component(Transform), player.is_prefab_instance)
scene.get_root_entities()  # parentless entities

docs.title: Foundation: Curve, Commands, Time Travel
docs.text:
core/foundation/ holds engine-wide utilities: Curve (keyframed float function), the Command/CommandHistory undo stack, and SnapshotRecorder (frame-by-frame scene snapshots for time travel).

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Curve (core/foundation/curve.py): @dataclass Curve(keys, pre_wrap="clamp", post_wrap="clamp"). CurveKey(time, value, in_tangent=0.0, out_tangent=0.0, tangent_mode=SMOOTH). TangentMode: FREE, LINEAR, CONSTANT, SMOOTH. add_key inserts sorted and re-smooths SMOOTH tangents; evaluate(t) clamps outside the key range, returns CONSTANT/LINEAR/Hermite inside. evaluate_array uses the Cython batch path when available. to_list/from_list store [[time, value]]; to_dict/from_dict keep tangents and wrap modes. QuaternionCurve is the slerp-interpolated rotation variant ((0,0,0,1) when empty).

Commands (core/foundation/cmd/): Command base (execute, undo, redo → re-execute, merge → False, description). CompoundCommand(commands, description) runs/reverts in order/reverse. CommandHistory(max_size=100): execute (clears redo), undo/redo, seek(target_head) for the history panel slider, mark_saved/is_dirty, can_undo/can_redo, undo_text/redo_text, undo_count/redo_count, description lists. get_history() returns the provider or a module singleton. Ready-made: CreateEntityCommand, DeleteEntityCommand, InstantiatePrefabCommand. execute and seek always emit the history_changed engine event; undo/redo emit it when change listeners are registered (add_on_change / set_on_undo / set_on_redo).

Time travel (core/foundation/time_travel.py): SnapshotRecorder(max_frames=600) keeps FrameSnapshot(frame_number, timestamp, entity_count, data, frame_time_ms) with md5 hash, optional camera_data, bookmarked, breakpoint_hit. capture_interval (default 1), filter_unchanged, breakpoint_expr (evaluated with scene_data, entity_count, frame, time; a truthy result stops recording). capture(scene) serializes the scene; restore(registry, index) deserializes a snapshot back into a Scene. Helpers: diff_scenes, find_entity_frame_changes, toggle_bookmark, export_frame.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: name type default description Curve.add_key(time, value) method — Sorted insert + auto-smooth; returns CurveKey Curve.evaluate(t) method 0.0 empty Clamped Hermite/LINEAR/CONSTANT interpolation TangentMode Enum SMOOTH free/linear/constant/smooth CommandHistory class max_size=100 Undo/redo/seek/dirty tracking history_changed event — Emitted on execute/seek always; on undo/redo when change listeners are registered SnapshotRecorder class max_frames=600 Ring buffer of scene snapshots SnapshotRecorder.capture_interval int 1 Record every Nth frame

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text: Curve editor panel edits Curve fields (inspector curve type). Undo history panel drives seek(). Time-travel panel drives start/stop/capture/restore/toggle_bookmark/export_frame.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.foundation.curve import Curve
from core.foundation.cmd.history import get_history
from core.foundation.cmd.entity_cmds import CreateEntityCommand
from core.foundation.time_travel import SnapshotRecorder
from core.ecs import ComponentRegistry

curve = Curve()
curve.add_key(0.0, 0.0)
curve.add_key(1.0, 10.0)
print(curve.evaluate(0.5))

history = get_history()
history.execute(CreateEntityCommand(scene, "Enemy"))
history.undo()

rec = SnapshotRecorder()
rec.start()
rec.capture(scene)
restored = rec.restore(ComponentRegistry, 0)

docs.title: Serialization
docs.text: Curves serialize as to_dict() (keys with time/value/in_tangent/out_tangent/tangent_mode, pre_wrap, post_wrap); ScriptComponent stores them under script_fields. Snapshots serialize as full scene dicts (export_frame writes one to JSON).

docs.title: Logging
docs.text:
Logger is a static level-filtered log with an in-memory ring buffer (2000 entries) and listener callbacks that feed the editor Console panel.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Levels are LogLevel.DEBUG = 0, INFO = 1, WARNING = 2, ERROR = 3; _min_level defaults to DEBUG so everything is recorded (debug/info/warning are gated; error() always emits). _emit appends a LogEntry(level, message, traceback_str) (timestamped with time.time()), drops the oldest entry past _max_entries = LOGGER_MAX_ENTRIES = 2000, then calls listeners (listener exceptions are swallowed). Logger.error(msg, exc) captures traceback.format_exc() only when exc is passed. main.py/player.py route unhandled exceptions through Logger.error with a full traceback.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: name type default description LogLevel IntEnum DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR = 0/1/2/3 Severity ordering debug / info / warning methods Logger.info(msg) Level-gated by _min_level error(msg, exc=None) method exc=None Appends traceback.format_exc() when exc given add_listener(fn) / remove_listener(fn) methods — fn(LogEntry); console panel subscribes here get_entries method copy of list Snapshot for UI rendering clear method — Drops all entries _max_entries int 2000 LOGGER_MAX_ENTRIES (core/config/constants.py) LogEntry fields slots — level, message, timestamp, traceback_str; helpers formatted_time() (%H:%M:%S), level_str()

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text: Console panel renders get_entries() (font settings under global config console.*). Engine, plugin, and script errors appear here with entity/component context.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.foundation.logger import Logger

Logger.info("Play mode started.")
Logger.warning("Missing texture, using fallback.")
try:
    risky()
except Exception as e:
    Logger.error(f"System failed: {e}", e)

Logger.add_listener(lambda entry: print(entry.level_str(), entry.formatted_time(), entry.message))

print(len(Logger.get_entries()))  # ring buffer holds at most 2000 entries
Logger.clear()  # drop all entries (runtime-only, never serialized)

docs.title: Profiler
docs.text:
Profiler (core/foundation/profiler.py) records nested timing sections into flat per-frame data plus an optional rolling buffer of 300 frames. Disabled by default; toggle profiler.enabled or engine.profiler_enabled.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: All methods are no-ops while enabled is False. start(key) pushes (key, perf_counter); stop(key) pops the matching entry (nested-safe: searches the stack when the top mismatches) and accumulates milliseconds into _flat_data. scope(key) is the context-manager form. set_value(key, ms) writes an absolute value (used for scene_serialize). capture_frame() seals the current frame (frame time, samples with depth + color from _PROFILER_COLORS) into a deque(maxlen=300). Engine exposes profiler, profiler_data, get_profiler_data(key, default), set_profiler_data, capture_profiler_frame(), reset_profiler(), and the profiler_enabled property. Engine-emitted keys include tick, fixed_update, update, scene_update, scene_fixed_update, scene_start, scene_serialize, plus per-plugin NAME sections and subsystem keys (physics_ms, render_scene, audio_ms, ui_ms, particle_ms, animation_ms, gizmo_lines, frame_overhead, …).

engine.profiler_enabled = True
with engine.profiler.scope("my_system"):
    step_simulation(dt)
engine.set_profiler_data("my_metric", 1.25)
print(engine.get_profiler_data("tick", 0.0))
engine.capture_profiler_frame()

docs.title: Registry and Serialization
docs.text:
ComponentRegistry maps type names to component classes via the @ComponentRegistry.register decorator. Scenes serialize to .zpes JSON: {"name", "entities": {id: entity-dict}}.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Registration is mandatory: an undecorated component class is invisible to Add Component menus and to deserialization (ARCHITECTURE.md: the architecture gate checks this). ComponentRegistry.get(name) resolves the class, honoring _aliases ({"Sky": "ProceduralSky"}). Categories are inferred from the module path (core.components.<sub> → display name via _category_name_map: transform→Transform, rendering→Rendering, physics→Physics, physics2d→Physics 2D, lighting→Lighting, audio→Audio, constraints→Constraints, network→Network, scripting→Scripting).

Scene serialization (core/ecs/scene_serialize.py): {"name", "entities": {id: entity-dict}} plus optional embed_all, compress_resources, compress_level. Deserialization rebuilds entities, then re-links parent ids and re-registers components in the scene index. Above 64 entities both directions use a thread pool. duplicate_entity / paste_entities assign fresh UUIDs and rebind Armature.bone_entity_ids.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: name type default description ComponentRegistry.register decorator required ComponentRegistry._registry[name] = cls; bumps subclass cache ComponentRegistry.get method get(name) Class or None; resolves Sky → ProceduralSky ComponentRegistry.all method all() Copy of the name → class map get_categories method per component e.g. ["Transform"] for Transform Scene.serialize method dict name, entities, optional embed/compress flags Scene.deserialize classmethod deserialize(data, registry) Rebuild + parent re-link + index sync PATH_FIELDS frozenset core/config/constants.py mesh_path, material_path, clip_path, script_path, texture_path, ply_path, shader_path, env_path, svg_path, font_path, video_path, graph_path, skybox_path — resolved against project_root on load, relativized on save

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text: Add Component groups come from get_categories. Unknown component types in a .zpes file are skipped silently on load (entity keeps the rest). Prefab instances carry prefab_guid / prefab_source_id; overrides serialize alongside the GUID.

docs.text:
from core.ecs import Component, ComponentRegistry

@ComponentRegistry.register
class Health(Component):
    pass

assert ComponentRegistry.get("Health") is Health
print(ComponentRegistry.get_categories("Health"))  # category by module path

data = scene.serialize()
scene2 = Scene.deserialize(data, ComponentRegistry)

docs.title: Time and Fixed Update
docs.text:
Frame time flows through Engine.tick(): accumulator + fixed steps (fixed_dt, default 0.02, max 5 steps) then one variable-dt update scaled by time_scale.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Engine.tick() is a no-op unless play_mode is True. tick_begin() flushes dirty transforms, measures raw dt with perf_counter, multiplies by time_scale, and accumulates into _fixed_accum (clamped to 5 * fixed_dt). Then up to MAX_FIXED_STEPS = 5 calls to tick_fixed_step() run Scene.fixed_update(fd) plus system-plugin pre_step/step, each consuming one fixed_dt. tick_update(dt) runs Scene.update(dt) once and updates FPS/TPS counters from unscaled time (0.5 s window). Engine.initialize() reads engine.time_scale (default 1.0) and engine.fixed_update_dt (default 0.02, minimum 0.001) from the global config.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: name type default description time_scale float 1.0 Setter clamps to >= 0.0; scales dt fixed_dt float 0.02 Setter clamps to >= 0.001 MAX_FIXED_STEPS int 5 Cap per tick() (local in loop.py, mirrored in core/config/constants.py) fps / tps float 0.0 Measured counters, 0.5 s window frame_count int 0 Incremented per tick_update tick() method — No-op when not in play mode on(event, cb) / off(event, cb) methods — Event bus (EngineEventsMixin)

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text: Play button → start_play() (resets accumulator, Scene.start(), starts GameWorker with rendering.tick_rate 120 Hz / rendering.fixed_tick_rate 60 Hz). Stop → stop_play() (stops worker and all audio). time_scale is editable in settings; 0 pauses logic time while frames continue.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
engine.time_scale = 0.5   # slow motion: dt halved
engine.fixed_dt = 1.0 / 60.0

def on_play(data):
    print("play started")

engine.on("play_start", on_play)
engine.off("play_start", on_play)

class PhysicsReader:
    def on_fixed_update(self, dt: float):
        assert dt == engine.fixed_dt  # constant step

docs.title: Transform
docs.text:
Transform (core.components.transform.tr) stores local position (Vec3), rotation (Quat), scale (Vec3) and computes the world matrix lazily from the parent chain.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Defaults: position (0,0,0), rotation identity Quat(0,0,0,1), scale (1,1,1). Any local setter marks the subtree dirty (_mark_dirty propagates to children, registers roots in Scene._dirty_roots, flags spatial + transform version). world_matrix recomputes on read when dirty: root entities write the local TRS matrix directly; children multiply local @ parent_world. The Inspector edits local_position (Position), local_euler_angles in degrees (Rotation), local_scale (Scale). Entity.set_parent(..., preserve_world=True) keeps the world matrix via the world_matrix setter. position reads the world translation; setting it converts to local space through the inverse parent matrix. forward is -Z of the world matrix (normalized), right is +X, up is +Y.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: name type default description local_position Vec3 (0,0,0) Accepts Vec3, ndarray, tuple/list local_rotation Quat identity Setter normalizes when given a Quat local_scale Vec3 (1,1,1) Accepts Vec3, ndarray, tuple/list local_euler_angles Vec3 (0,0,0) deg Euler view of the quaternion (Quat.from_euler on set) position Vec3 world origin World-space translation; setter converts to local world_matrix Mat4 identity Lazy; recomputed while _dirty forward / right / up Vec3 axes Normalized world axes (-Z / +X / +Y) translate(delta, world_space=False) method — Local add, or world-space via position rotate(euler) method — euler in degrees; post-multiplies local quaternion look_at(target, up) method up=None (defaults to Vec3.up()) Sets local_rotation via Quat.look_rotation world set setter — Deferred through _world_target, decomposed on flush

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text: Inspector → Transform: Position / Rotation (degrees) / Scale numeric fields. Viewport gizmo drag writes the same locals. Reparent in Hierarchy preserves world placement (preserve_world=True).

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.components.transform.tr import Transform
from core.maths.math3d import Vec3

tr = entity.add_component(Transform())
tr.local_position = Vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)
tr.local_euler_angles = Vec3(0.0, 45.0, 0.0)
tr.local_scale = Vec3(2.0, 2.0, 2.0)

tr.translate(Vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))   # local move
tr.rotate(Vec3(0.0, 90.0, 0.0))     # degrees
print(tr.position)                  # world-space Vec3
print(tr.forward)                   # world -Z

tr.translate(Vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), world_space=True)  # via world position
tr.look_at(Vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0))  # local_rotation via Quat.look_rotation

docs.title: Commands and Undo
docs.text:
CommandHistory(max_size=100) is the editor undo stack: execute / undo / redo / seek, dirty tracking, and the history_changed engine event. Ready-made commands cover entity operations.

Home | Section index

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Command is the base (execute, undo, redo re-calls execute, merge returns False, description defaults to the class name). CompoundCommand(commands, description) executes in order and undoes in reverse. CommandHistory(max_size=100) owns an undo stack and a redo stack plus parallel selection snapshots:

  • execute(command) runs the command, pushes it, clears the redo stack, trims to max_size (dropping the oldest and shifting _saved_index), and always emits history_changed.
  • undo() / redo() move one command between stacks, restore the recorded selection, set last_affected_entity (extracted from _entity / _entity_id / nested _commands), and emit history_changed only when change listeners are registered and recording is on.
  • seek(target_head) jumps the undo-stack head to an absolute position (undoes or redoes N steps); always emits history_changed. This is what the Undo History panel slider drives.
  • Dirty tracking: mark_saved() records the stack length; is_dirty compares lengths. clear() empties both stacks and resets the saved index.
  • Listeners: add_on_change(cb) registers the callback for both undo and redo; set_on_undo(cb) / set_on_redo(cb) manage each list (None clears it). Callbacks receive the affected Command.
  • Introspection: can_undo / can_redo, undo_count / redo_count, undo_text ("Undo <description>") / redo_text, get_undo_descriptions() / get_redo_descriptions(), current_selection.
  • get_history() returns the injected provider (set_history_provider) or a module-level singleton.

Ready-made commands live in core/foundation/cmd/: CreateEntityCommand, DeleteEntityCommand, InstantiatePrefabCommand (entity_cmds.py), component add/remove/set commands (component_cmds.py).

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: name type default description CommandHistory(max_size) class 100 Undo/redo stacks with cap execute(cmd) method — Run, push, clear redo, always emits history_changed undo() / redo() methods — Move one command; emit only with registered listeners seek(target_head) method — Jump to absolute head position; always emits mark_saved() / is_dirty method / prop — Save-point vs current length clear() method — Empty stacks, reset saved index add_on_change(cb) method — Listen on both undo and redo set_on_undo(cb) / set_on_redo(cb) methods — Per-direction listeners; None clears undo_text / redo_text props "Can't ..." Menu labels with last description last_affected_entity prop None Entity extracted from last undone/redone command get_history() function singleton Provider or module-global history

docs.title: Usage in Editor
docs.text: The Undo History panel (editor/panels/undo_history_panel.py) refreshes on a 500 ms timer when undo_count:redo_count changes, lists undo descriptions above and redo descriptions below a --- Current State --- separator, and calls seek(target) on click (row payload is i + 1). The hierarchy panel subscribes via engine.on("history_changed", ...) to refresh on every change.

docs.title: Usage in Code
docs.text:
from core.foundation.cmd.history import get_history
from core.foundation.cmd.entity_cmds import CreateEntityCommand, DeleteEntityCommand

history = get_history()
history.execute(CreateEntityCommand(scene, "Enemy"))
print(history.undo_text)  # "Undo CreateEntityCommand" (or the command's description)
history.undo()
history.redo()
history.seek(0)  # back to the oldest state

history.add_on_change(lambda cmd: print("changed:", cmd.description))
history.mark_saved()
print(history.is_dirty)

docs.title: Serialization
docs.text: Commands are not serialized; only their effects persist via normal scene serialization. mark_saved/is_dirty is the unsaved-changes signal for the editor save flow.
